notes.kalsbeek-huizenga-vanreken-hall: Pinned on OSM's Kalsbeek-Huizenga-vanReken dormitory (way/225173810, named without the space our list has); Calvin's campus map (calvin.edu/directory/map) shows it at the north end of the Knollcrest residence halls.
notes.rooks-vandellen-hall: Pinned on OSM's Rooks-VanDellen dormitory (way/225173801, named without the space our list has); Calvin's campus map (calvin.edu/directory/map) shows it between Bolt-Heyns-Timmer and Noordewier-VanderWerp.
notes.calvin-crossing: Calvin Crossing is the pedestrian bridge over the East Beltline (OSM building=bridge), not a class building.
notes.van-noord-arena: Varsity basketball and volleyball arena in the Spoelhof Fieldhouse Complex, not a class building or student gym (calvin.edu/athletics/facilities).
notes.huizenga-tennis-and-track-center: Varsity tennis and indoor track venue, not a class building or student gym (calvin.edu/athletics/facilities).
notes.venema-aquatic-center: The swim and dive pool of the Spoelhof Fieldhouse Complex, a varsity venue rather than a class building; the complex itself stays (calvin.edu/athletics/facilities).
notes.prince-conference-center: Calvin's conference centre and guest lodging (calvin.edu/prince-conference-center), not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.calvin-theological-seminary: A separate graduate seminary on the south edge of campus (calvinseminary.edu), not somewhere undergraduates have class.

detours.why: Bolt-Heyns-Timmer's mapped door faces the quad path on its east side, so the walk to the Science Building goes north round the hall and down its west side; OSM maps no path straight across the lawn between them.
